Intel: Python code with syntax errors should report diagnostics

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const tree_sitter_language_pack = @import("tree_sitter_language_pack");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try tree_sitter_language_pack.process("def broken(\n    pass\n", "{\"diagnostics\":true,\"language\":\"python\"}");
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});

}
```
